name: write-notes
description: 让 AI 改代码前先看见当初为什么这样定：把决策、取舍与被否掉的老路留在仓库里，用脚本门禁保证同步

scripts.verify-notes: npx tsx skills/write-notes/scripts/verify-agent-note-tree.ts && npx tsx skills/write-notes/scripts/verify-agent-note-format.ts && npx tsx skills/write-notes/scripts/verify-archived-agent-notes.ts
scripts.init-board: npx tsx skills/write-notes/scripts/build-board.ts --init board.html '工程决策看板'
scripts.bundle-board: npx tsx skills/write-notes/scripts/build-board.ts --bundle .agents/notes demo.html '工程决策看板'
scripts.build-board: npx tsx skills/write-notes/scripts/build-board.ts --init board.html '工程决策看板'
scripts.verify-notes-en: npx tsx skills/write-notes-en/scripts/verify-agent-note-tree.ts && npx tsx skills/write-notes-en/scripts/verify-agent-note-format.ts && npx tsx skills/write-notes-en/scripts/verify-archived-agent-notes.ts
